summary: The deadlock arises because the two worker threads acquire the two locks in opposite orders: helperAddBad takes BAD_NUMBER1_LOCK then BAD_NUMBER2_LOCK, while helperMultiplyBad takes BAD_NUMBER2_LOCK then BAD_NUMBER1_LOCK. With both holding their first lock and waiting on the other, they deadlock. The fix enforces a consistent global lock-ordering (always acquire BAD_NUMBER1_LOCK before BAD_NUMBER2_LOCK), matching the good variant, so both the add and multiply operations still execute and update intBadNumber1.
